items.coder_A: Paediatric-oriented CNS tumour trial (age up to 21, CHILD and ADULT); glioblastoma only appears in conditions; could alternatively be coded basket_gbm_eligible or not_glioblastoma.
items.reason: Glioblastoma is named in the conditions ('High Grade Glioma; Glioblastoma; Medulloblastoma'), which C7 accepts, and several glioma types are eligible; the age cap (≤ 21) is handled by the mixed_age flag, not S5. basket_gbm_eligible would also include it, so the choice does not change screening.

note: Moot: the only agent is B7-H3 CAR T cells (excluded type), so excluded at S6. GBM can only enter Cohort A (relapsed/refractory, B7-H3 positive). B7-H3 and H3K27M requirements are not candidate-matched (no candidate).
